_comment: English twin of data/ru/conversations.json: the same people, the same dialogs, the same frames — only the prose differs. Seven visible dialogs mirror frames A–H and A1 one for one; Maria's contact history is frame F. The remaining features (the VIP group, HTML mail, the portal and the customer-account snapshot, spam) are covered by archived and spam dialogs that are not in the main list. Time is relative: «now» = the moment of installation.

replyTemplates.title: Greeting
replyTemplates.text: Hello! My name is {name}, I am a consultant at Nord Atelier. Could you tell me the track width and the window drop — I will work out a quote.

replyTemplates.title: Lead times
replyTemplates.text: Making takes 5–7 working days after payment. An express option in 3 days is possible if the fabric is in stock, at +30% of the making price.

replyTemplates.title: DPD delivery
replyTemplates.text: We send by DPD to a pickup point or to your door, 3–5 working days. The tracking number arrives by e-mail on the day of dispatch, by 19:00.

replyTemplates.title: Moving a delivery
replyTemplates.text: We have moved your delivery to {date}, slot {slot}. The courier will call an hour ahead. Please confirm that the slot works for you.

replyTemplates.title: Returns — asking for photos
replyTemplates.text: I am sorry this happened. Please send the order number and photographs of the item in daylight — I will raise a claim for a remake or an exchange.

replyTemplates.title: Fabric samples
replyTemplates.text: We will post up to 5 samples free of charge. Tell us which fabrics and colours you would like, and the address with the postcode.

replyTemplates.title: Closing a dialog
replyTemplates.text: Glad to have helped! If anything else comes up, write to us — I answer during working hours, 10:00 to 20:00.
